scope: Own compressed package, unpacked file payload, installed dependency trees, and fresh-process gem loading
baseline: The working tree at the start of this episode includes the preceding adapter audit and parallel local release preparation. The optional-loading comparisons use corrected as their baseline, isolating the standalone blank-extension repair.
sampling: Seven alternating fresh child processes per side; warm filesystem caches; Bundler setup and optional host preloading outside the timed region; native process-lifetime RSS includes setup and reporting.
units: Archive bytes are compressed .gem bytes; package_file_bytes are raw file contents; dependency bytes are logical installed files including native extensions and documentation, excluding registry caches and the Ruby interpreter.
